candidates.label: Minimum adjacent swaps to sort = number of inversions, counted via O(n^2) double loop (N<=1000, trivially fast).
Inner loop stops one short of the end (j<n-1), so inversions involving the very last element are never counted.
Uses 'if (cin >> n)' instead of 'while' -- only ever processes the first dataset in the EOF-terminated stream, silently dropping every subsequent one.
